QuestInfo.name: Help Agent E!
QuestInfo.1:
Today's Mission!!
<Complete Agent E's #bSpecial Operation Quest#k!> 

Agent E frequently assigns special operations to the agents to collect information on #bMaster M#k.  In order to receive a special operation from Agent E, go to Agent E who is in each town.

0.0: You want to receive today's mission again?

yes.0: I frequently give special orders to agents in order to collect information on #bMaster M#k.  If you want to receive one of these special orders, come see me.  I am located at just about every town.

no.0: If you want to receive it again, just let me know.

1.0: Good job.  You have completed today's mission.  Your mission performance file is scheduled to be reported to headquarters.
